title: Nine Pins of Winter
subtitle: 保龄球 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 保龄球（文学艺术与体育·体育与运动）
meta: 主题语境：保龄球（文学艺术与体育·体育与运动）　|　核心词汇：bowling　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bowling 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 my mother was sent to keep ① a bowling score she could not read, and she said the reading was the whole of the lesson. The ② bowling, meaning the game and not the alley, was nine pins and was played by whoever came last; bowling, she said, is the only thing in a club that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ bowling club in that league had the same lane, and the ④ bowling at the end, meaning the one the keeper played and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever scored properly. Bowling, my grandmother said, is nine parts aim and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the aim is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ bowling was the whole of the winter, meaning the season it filled and not the game. The ⑥ bowling, meaning the winter and not any of that, is the only thing in a town that everybody books and nobody questions; bowling, he said, is either something you score or the only word that means both a game and a winter. She said the winter is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ bowling had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the lane. The ⑧ bowling of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine pins and eleven years of scoring; bowling, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ bowling I remember is the one at the end, which was filmed in 1981 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ bowling night, my grandmother said in 1984, is the only thing that improves by being played; every bowling, she said, is a winter that has agreed to look like a game. She said the winter was the honest half.

answers.why: keep a bowling score 意为“记录保龄球比分”，1964 年母亲被派去记一份她看不懂的比分。
bowling 意为“保龄球”，指这项运动本身而不是球道，共九个球瓶，由最后来的人打。
bowling 指联赛里各俱乐部打的每一场保龄球，都用同一条球道。
bowling 指末尾那一局（管理人打的那一局），是唯一有人认真记过分的。
bowling 意为“保龄球”，抽象指它填满的那个冬天，父亲说 bowling 就是那个冬天的全部。
bowling 为抽象用法，指那个冬天本身，是镇上人人都预订、却没人质疑的东西。
bowling 意为“保龄球运动”，到 1978 年这项 bowling 成了报告里的一张照片。
bowling 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九个球瓶和十一年的记分。
bowling 意为“保龄球”，我记得的是末尾那一局，1981 年被拍下来，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
bowling 为抽象总称，祖母说保龄球之夜是唯一会因为真的打了而变好的东西。
